programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain - Lancashire Hot Pot
programme.desc: Adam is in Lancashire to taste the historic, hearty hot pot. He also samples a banging Brazilian sausage roll, world-famous black pudding from a secret recipe and a wonderful chicken-topped waffle.

programme.title: Carnival Eats - Children of the Corn on the Cob
programme.desc: S5E4 - Noah samples the menu at the Three Rivers Festival in Fort Wayne, Ind., from an enchilada funnel cake to bacon barbecue corn; Noah hits the Orange County Fair in Costa Mesa, Calif. Where he samples Drunken Pickle Pops and the Pineapple Unicorn Bomb.

programme.title: Carnival Eats - Eating Las Vegas
programme.desc: S5E10 - Noah Cappe investigates the Great American Foodie Fest in Nevada and gets lucky with some monster meat meals like the Katsu Curry Sandwich; at the Kittitas County Fair in Washington, Noah goes local with the Beefalo Burger and Hucklepeach Donuts.

programme.title: Carnival Eats - The Waffle Truth
programme.desc: S5E12 - The Circleville Pumpkin Show in Ohio, where pumpkin stars in treats like Pumpkin Chili Dogs and Fall Favorite Taffy; Southern favorites including True Grits and Banana Split Pudding Bites are at the North Carolina State Fair in Raleigh.

programme.title: Carnival Eats - Noah's Favs
programme.desc: S5E18 - After trying almost 500 fairground foods, Noah Cappe becomes a midway culinary expert; now he shares his personal greatest hits by taking a trip down the memory midway of his favorite foods.

programme.title: Carnival Eats - Camp Pop
programme.desc: S8E3 - The Super Ramen Dog combines two delicious foods Noah didn't know belonged together; the Elephant Ear Taco is a new take on a fairground favorite; and the Peanut Pop Shake has Noah all shook up.

programme.title: Carnival Eats - Fries in Disguise
programme.desc: S8E12 - Noah Cappe arrives at the Volusia County Fair in Florida, where two carnival classics get a makeover for the Cheesy Tater Corn Dog and the Black Forest Funnel Cake; fusion fair food with the Phorrito, Jacked Up Fries and Cannoli Nachos.

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Sandwiches
programme.desc: S1E7 - Roger searches for the country's 15 best sandwiches while learning about sandwich techniques and the grand assortment of culinary delights one can place between two slices of bread.

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Surf and Turf
programme.desc: S2E9 - The best surf-and-turf dishes in restaurants across America, including the classic lobster tail and steak, clam and bacon pizza, crab cakes with sausage, and even a lobster-and-steak roll.

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Pub Grub
programme.desc: S4E4 - Roger Mooking goes on a pub crawl to find 15 of the best dishes to go with any drink; chicken wings, nachos, sliders, apps and mains -- they're all here; chefs share insider tips and tricks for making the very best, tastiest bar fare.

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Super-Sized
programme.desc: S2E11 - The 12 best super-sized dishes; Roger Mooking hangs out with chefs to learn all their secrets for creating ultimate omelets, steaks, sandwiches, seafood platters and more decadent, XXL-sized dishes.

programme.title: Food Paradise - Click on the Link
programme.desc: S14E52 - People love sausage, whether they're long links, plump patties or spicy little slices; sampling the best the United States has to offer, including a chorizo burger, a sausage sampler, a Cajun sausage po' boy, and wood-fired venison hot dog.

programme.title: Food Paradise - Monster Mashups
programme.desc: S14E45 - The craziest mash-ups; the Pizzarito in New York; nachos with macaroni and cheese in Wisconsin; Mexican and Asian food in Arizona; low-country boils with pizza in Chicago.

programme.title: Food Paradise - Charleston Chowdown
programme.desc: S15E1 - The evolving food scene in Charleston, S.C.; country classics like smothered catfish share the table with notable newcomers, like a grilled BBQ brisket and pimento cheese sandwich and a breakfast pizza.

programme.title: Food Paradise - Outdoor Eats
programme.desc: S14E48 - At Saltwater Cowboys, shrimp boats come in while people chow down on BBQ pork trashcan nachos; sky-high chimichangas with rooftop views; al pastor fries on the lawn of Golden Road Brewing.

programme.title: Man Fire Food - One-of-a-Kind Rigs
programme.desc: S5E11 - Roger meets Josh Pollack, owner of Rosenberg's Bagels & Delicatessen in Denver, whose 8-foot steel contraption cooks up to 1,000 pounds of food.

programme.title: Man Fire Food - Old School, New School
programme.desc: S6E1 - Carolina-style barbecue is all about pork and Rodney Scott is the whole hog boss; Roger checks out Rodney's impressive new pit room where whole hogs get cooked low and slow; Rodney hits the hogs with his secret.

programme.title: Man Fire Food - Red-Hot Roasts
programme.desc: S9E4 - Roger visits two caterers in the South who specialize in live-fire cookouts: Argentinian grill master Mariano Cebrián in Chattanooga, Tenn., and Chef Kristian Niemi of Honey River Catering in Columbia, S.C.

programme.title: Man Fire Food - Backyard Feast
programme.desc: S1E9 - Outdoor smoker; lamb rotisserie; coal-baked potatoes.

programme.title: Man Fire Food - Smoking and Spit-Roasting in Texas
programme.desc: S8E8 - Roger is in Austin and helps Banger's Sausage House and Beer Garden pitmaster Ted Prater season a whole hog and smoke it for 10 hours for Carolina-style sandwiches; Roger and Pieter Sypesteyn stuff a wild hog. (Cooking)

programme.title: Man Fire Food - BBQ and Boils in the Bayou
programme.desc: S8E10 - Roger Mooking visits the Louisiana bayou for barbecue, brunch and a crawfish boil; he helps prepare brisket and baby back ribs in Prairieville. (Cooking)

programme.desc: S1E1 - Delicious eats in Charleston, S.C. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Roadtrip With G. Garvin - Houston
programme.desc: S1E2 - G heads to Houston for a reminder of what a true Texan barbecue is; first stop is Tin Roof, a family-friendly spot with live entertainment and a father and son team working the smokers. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Roadtrip With G. Garvin - Nashville
programme.desc: S2E4 - Pork loin with greens; mac and cheese; hot chicken; fried chicken livers; prime rib sandwich. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Roadtrip With G. Garvin - Southern California
programme.desc: S2E11 - Green veggie salad; bacon cheddar biscuits; BBQ chicken pizza. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Sweet Deals Down South
programme.desc: S5E2 - A classic Southern haystack piled high with cheesy grits, hash browns and salsa; lunch gets explosive at Betty Bombers with the juicy and spicy Fire in the Hole burger. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Providence Eats
programme.desc: S3E11 - Ali dives into a delectable Portuguese sweet bread French toast; he then sinks his teeth into a classic meatball sub from a landmark Providence sandwich shop; then Ali gets his seafood on with a Quahog clam and chorizo. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - C-Ville Eats
programme.desc: S3E2 - Ali visits Charlottesville, Va. for breakfast, lunch, dinner and a snack; college town food has never tasted so good as Ali starts with a breakfast bagel chock-full of deli meat. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Flavors of Cincinnati
programme.desc: S3E8 - In Cincinnati, Ohio, Ali hits the ground running with a fancy French puff pastry and goetta breakfast, before digging into a 5-way with Cincinnati-style chili; Ali enjoys lemon ricotta cake and devours a decadent whiskey barbecue bacon burger. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Big Sky, Big Game, Big Flavor!
programme.desc: S2E4 - Ali's search for the best deals in Bozeman, Mont., begins with farm-to-table fresh Benedict and summer sausage before trying a made-from-scratch elk burger; Ali discovers a huckleberry bar and sinks his teeth into a bison pepperoni pizza. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Cheap Eats - Hot Deals in the Desert

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Slammin' Hot and Smoky
programme.desc: S4E6 - A slammin' sandwich with three different cuts of pork smothered in triple-cheese sauce; a flaming hot burger stuffed with spicy jalapeño Jack cheese and covered in Buffalo sauce; a brewery's drunken chicken pot pie. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Beastly Burgers

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Smokehouse Reinventions

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Wild Smoke and Fiery Burgers
programme.desc: S6E6 - Michael Symon eats a spicy burger that ignites a four-alarm fire; chorizo-pineapple burger; cheesy grits with a pile of blood orange, and IPA, braised pork; a classic Reuben sandwich gets a smoky upgrade; spicy venison bologna. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Meatloaded Makeovers

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Houston
programme.desc: S3E18 - Uncovering eclectic eats in Houston; from Tex-Mex steak fajitas and cheesy Czech pastries to Creole classics and Vietnamese-Cajun crawfish, Houston is a flavorful fusion of Wild West, Far East and Deep South. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Berlin

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Brussels

programme.title: Murder in a Small Town
programme.desc: Karl Alberg moves to the idyllic coastal town of Gibsons to become the new police chief and soothe a psyche that has been battered by big-city police work. Unfortunately, the gentle paradise has more than its share of secrets, and Karl needs to call upon all the skills that made him a world-class detective in solving the murders that, even in this seemingly idyllic setting, continue to wash up on his shore. Cassandra, a local librarian, becomes Alberg's muse, foil and romantic interest. The show is based on the Edgar Award-winning, nine-book "Karl Alberg" series by acclaimed novelist L.R. Wright. - Rossif Sutherland, Kristin Kreuk, Marcia Gay Harden, Peter Gallagher (Crime drama)

programme.title: Nation's Dumbest
programme.desc: "Nation's Dumbest" is a celebrity competition series with a twisted premise: it's the only game show where winning is the last thing anyone wants. Famous faces are sent back to "summer school" and must relive the highs and humiliations of school life through a mix of brain-teasing pop quizzes, fast-paced physical challenges, and tests built on long-buried classroom knowledge. Rather than striving for a top prize, contestants battle to stay out of last place, because the worst performer is publicly humiliated with the unwanted title of "The Nation's Dumbest." Each week, the "smartest" celebrity graduates and leaves the competition, narrowing the field until a high-stakes final exam determines who ultimately fails their way to the infamous crown. The show channels a spirit of playful self-mockery, celebrating humor, humility, and the universal experience of not always getting it right. (Game show)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire.

programme.title: Bang Bang
programme.desc: Following Bang Bang Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past.

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: A pilot (Robert Hays) afraid to fly follows his stewardess ex-girlfriend (Julie Hagerty) and must take over for the poisoned crew.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: The reopening of Camp Crystal Lake spells murder and mayhem for a group of sexually promiscuous counselors.

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2
programme.desc: Mrs. Voorhees' son Jason is waiting when another load of teens (Amy Steel, John Furey, Adrienne King) tries to make a buck at Camp Crystal.

programme.title: Buddy Games: Spring Awakening
programme.desc: Faced with their biggest challenge yet, the gang sets out to honor a lost pal, only to find themselves in the middle of where it all began -- spring break. They soon learn their old school ways of partying can hardly compete with today's generation.

programme.title: Soul Men
programme.desc: Old animosities re-emerge when two estranged singers (Samuel L. Jackson, Bernie Mac) travel cross-country to perform in a tribute concert for their late band leader.

programme.title: The Hangover
programme.desc: After a wild stag party in Las Vegas, three hazy groomsmen (Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis) must find their missing friend and get him back to Los Angeles in time for his wedding.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). - Tom Cruise, Kelly McGillis, Anthony Edwards, Val Kilmer, Tom Skerritt (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: After more than 30 years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators, Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is where he belongs, pushing the envelope as a courageous test pilot and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him. Training a detachment of graduates for a special assignment, Maverick must confront the ghosts of his past and his deepest fears, culminating in a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those who choose to fly it. - Tom Cruise, Miles Teller, Jennifer Connelly, Jon Hamm, Glen Powell (Action, Adventure)

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. - Daniel Day-Lewis, Paul Dano, Kevin J. O'Connor, Ciarán Hinds, Dillon Freasier (Drama)

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part IV: The Final Chapter
programme.desc: A carefree lakeside vacation is interrupted by the re-emergence of killer Jason Voorhees (Ted White). After he escapes from a morgue, leaving bodies in his wake, Jason travels to Camp Crystal Lake where a group of friends is staying. The teens meet some locals: Tommy (Corey Feldman) and Trish (Kimberly Beck), as well as secretive hiker Rob (Erich Anderson). As the group of teenagers engages in drunken debauchery, their numbers begin to dwindle, and pieces of the past resurface. - Kimberly Beck, Peter Barton, Corey Feldman, Crispin Glover, Barbara Howard (Horror, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: This spoof comedy takes shots at the slew of disaster movies that were released in the 70s. When the passengers and crew of a jet are incapacitated due to food poisoning, a rogue pilot with a drinking problem must cooperate with his ex-girlfriend turned stewardess to bring the plane to a safe landing. - Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Peter Graves, Robert Stack, Lloyd Bridges (Dark comedy)

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes. - Goldie Hawn, Bette Midler, Diane Keaton, Maggie Smith, Sarah Jessica Parker (Comedy)

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
programme.desc: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman. - John Doman (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: The Comeback Trail
programme.desc: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making. - Robert De Niro, Tommy Lee Jones, Morgan Freeman, Zach Braff, Emile Hirsch (Comedy)

programme.title: Faster
programme.desc: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. - Dwayne Johnson, Billy Bob Thornton, Oliver Jackson-Cohen, Carla Gugino, Maggie Grace (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Dictator
programme.desc: Gen. Aladeen (Sacha Baron Cohen) has ruled the oil-rich North African country of Wadiya since the age of six, when 97 stray bullets and a hand grenade killed his father in a hunting accident. After an assassination attempt takes the life of yet another body-double, Tamir (Ben Kingsley), Aladeen's uncle and most trusted adviser, convinces Aladeen to go to New York. Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule. - Sacha Baron Cohen, Anna Faris, Ben Kingsley, Jason Mantzoukas, Kevin Corrigan (Comedy)

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them. - Shia LaBeouf, Michelle Monaghan, Rosario Dawson, Michael Chiklis, Anthony Mackie (Family, Action, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Anthropoid
programme.desc: In December 1941, two Czech soldiers (Cillian Murphy, Jamie Dornan) parachute into their occupied homeland to assassinate Nazi officer Reinhard Heydrich (Detlef Bothe). - Cillian Murphy, Jamie Dornan, Charlotte Le Bon, Anna Geislerová, Toby Jones (Historical drama, War, Thriller)

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: The Enterprise and its crew follow a Borg ship through a time warp to prevent the Borg from taking over the Earth in a past era. Stuck in the past, Geordi La Forge helps a pioneer of space travel in his efforts to create the first warp drive while Capt. Picard and Cmdr. Data battle the Borg Queen as she tries to take over the Enterprise. - Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton, Michael Dorn (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: In Mexico City, a newly modified liquid Terminator -- the Rev-9 model -- arrives from the future to kill a young factory worker named Dani Ramos. Also sent back in time is Grace, a hybrid cyborg human who must protect Ramos from the seemingly indestructible robotic assassin. But the two women soon find some much-needed help from a pair of unexpected allies -- seasoned warrior Sarah Connor and the T-800 Terminator. - Linda Hamilton, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Mackenzie Davis, Natalia Reyes, Gabriel Luna (Science fiction, Action)

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalsky, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space. - Sandra Bullock, George Clooney, Adam Cozens (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration. - Amanda Plummer, Ulrich Thomsen, Costas Mandylor, James Russo, Barkhad Abdi (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Here and Now
programme.desc: After receiving a grim diagnosis, a successful New York singer spends the day reflecting on her life. She crisscrosses the city as she attempts to make peace with her friends, family and failures. - Sarah Jessica Parker, Renée Zellweger, Taylor Kinney, Simon Baker, Jacqueline Bisset (Drama)

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. - Michael Douglas, Glenn Close, Anne Archer, Ellen Hamilton Latzen, Stuart Pankin (Thriller, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board. - Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Lloyd Bridges, Peter Graves, William Shatner (Science fiction, Dark comedy)

programme.title: Winter Spring Summer or Fall
programme.desc: Young Remi has her future figured out, until she meets Barnes, who lives for the moment and makes her question everything. As their love story unfolds, she faces a choice -- stick to her plan or risk it all for a life she never saw coming. - Jenna Ortega, Percy Hynes White, Marisol Nichols, Adam Rodriguez, Elias Kacavas (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Tom Cruise and Cameron Crowe reunite after "Jerry Maguire" for "Vanilla Sky," the story of a young New York City publishing magnate who finds himself on an unexpected roller-coaster ride of romance, comedy, suspicion, love, sex and dreams in a mind-bending search for his soul. - Tom Cruise, Penélope Cruz, Cameron Diaz, Kurt Russell, Jason Lee (Thriller, Drama, Romance, Science fiction, Mystery)

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
programme.desc: Years ago, Tommy Jarvis (Thom Mathews) killed infamous hockey-masked murderer Jason Voorhees (C.J. Graham), and the intensity of the experience has landed him in a mental institution. To end his torment and achieve a level of closure, Tommy escapes from the hospital and heads to the graveyard where Jason is buried, intending to dig up the body and cremate it. But, before this total annihilation can occur, a freak electrical accident resurrects Jason from the dead, and the terror begins anew. - Thom Mathews, Jennifer Cooke, Ron Palillo, David Kagen, Renee Jones (Horror, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: A transplanted New Yorker attempting to acclimate to Los Angeles, Mike Peters (Jon Favreau), is struggling to both boost his comedy career and get over his last relationship. A self-proclaimed master of seduction, Mike's buddy, Trent Walker (Vince Vaughn), tries to show him how to make connections and get the attention of women. Slowly moving toward regaining his confidence, Mike meets the gorgeous and down-to-earth Lorraine (Heather Graham), sparking a welcome new romance. - Jon Favreau, Vince Vaughn, Ron Livingston, Patrick Van Horn, Alex Désert (Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world. - John Goodman, Mary Elizabeth Winstead, John Gallagher Jr., Douglas M. Griffin, Suzanne Cryer (Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Face/Off
programme.desc: Obsessed with bringing terrorist Castor Troy (Nicolas Cage) to justice, FBI agent Sean Archer (John Travolta) tracks down Troy, who has boarded a plane in Los Angeles. After the plane crashes and Troy is severely injured, possibly dead, Archer undergoes surgery to remove his face and replace it with Troy's. As Archer tries to use his disguise to elicit information about a bomb from Troy's brother, Troy awakes from a coma and forces the doctor who performed the surgery to give him Archer's face. - John Travolta, Nicolas Cage, Joan Allen, Alessandro Nivola, Gina Gershon (Action, Crime drama)

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: After serving time in prison for taking the fall for a group of his friends, Leo just wants to get his life back on track. So he goes to the one place he thinks will be safe -- home. There he takes a new job with his highly connected and influential uncle. But in the yards, where his uncle now pulls the strings, safe is not how they do business. Unwittingly, he's drawn into a world of sabotage, high stakes payoffs and even murder. - Mark Wahlberg, Joaquin Phoenix, Charlize Theron, James Caan, Ellen Burstyn (Crime drama)

programme.title: Flight
programme.desc: A veteran pilot (Denzel Washington) makes a miraculous landing after a mechanical malfunction sends his plane hurtling toward the ground, but an investigation into the incident reveals that he was drunk at the time.

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: A beautiful globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) battles otherworldly creatures for possession of a powerful artifact.

programme.title: The Girl in the Pool
programme.desc: A man's life collapses when his mistress is found dead in his pool. Terrified of the consequences and desperate to protect his family, he conceals the truth, triggering a chaotic night that threatens to unravel his perfect life.

programme.title: Before Dawn
programme.desc: A young man joins his countrymen on the Western front of World War I, hoping to expedite an end to the bloody conflict. However, as the battle rages on, he's forced to grapple with the brutal realities of trench warfare.

programme.title: The Comeback Trail
programme.desc: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: The sheriff (Sylvester Stallone) of a small New Jersey police community confronts key men (Harvey Keitel, Ray Liotta) on both sides of a law-enforcement cover-up.

programme.title: Everybody Wants Some!!
programme.desc: In 1980 Texas, a college freshman meets his new baseball teammates, an unruly group of disco-dancing, skirt-chasing partiers.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity.

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, and they join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

programme.title: Out of the Furnace
programme.desc: Steelworker Russell Baze works a dead-end job and holds tight to his sense of family, duty and loyalty. Rodney Baze, Russell's brother, returns home after serving in Iraq and, with his debts piling up, becomes entangled with a vicious crime lord. Soon afterward, Rodney disappears mysteriously. The police fail to solve the case, so Russell -- feeling he has little left to lose -- puts his life on the line to bring his brother home. - Christian Bale, Woody Harrelson, Casey Affleck, Forest Whitaker, Willem Dafoe (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: The Machinist
programme.desc: Factory worker Trevor Reznik (Christian Bale) suffers from insomnia so severe that his condition has taken its toll on his weight and his mental health. When Trevor unintentionally causes an on-the-job accident that horribly injures a coworker (Michael Ironside), he begins to become even more troubled. Despite a relationship with Stevie (Jennifer Jason Leigh), a pretty prostitute, Trevor descends further into paranoia, blaming his problems on an enigmatic figure named Ivan (John Sharian). - Christian Bale, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, John Sharian, Michael Ironside (Thriller)

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: After losing his mother to murder as a boy, Marcus (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) has little support in his life. He starts working for drug dealer Levar (Bill Duke) and his assistant (Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje). Although Marcus makes good money selling, his dream is to become a rapper. When he reunites with an old love (Joy Bryant) and is later shot numerous times during a robbery, Marcus decides it's time to change his life. However, his old associates won't let him go so easily. - Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson, Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, Walter Alza, Serena Reeder, Benz Antoine (Crime drama, Music, Hip-Hop & rap, Action)

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: On the run from a bank robbery that left several police officers dead, Seth Gecko (George Clooney) and his paranoid, loose-cannon brother, Richard (Quentin Tarantino), hightail it to the Mexican border. Kidnapping preacher Jacob Fuller (Harvey Keitel) and his kids, the criminals sneak across the border in the family's RV and hole up in a topless bar. Unfortunately, the bar also happens to be home base for a gang of vampires, and the brothers and their hostages have to fight their way out. - Harvey Keitel, George Clooney, Quentin Tarantino, Juliette Lewis, Cheech Marin (Horror, Action, Dark comedy, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part V: A New Beginning
programme.desc: Years after Tommy Jarvis (John Shepherd) murdered hockey-masked serial killer Jason Voorhees, he resides in a mental hospital and struggles with the trauma of the experience. When Tommy moves to an isolated halfway house, he has nightmares about Jason's return, and soon one of the patients (Dominick Brascia) is killed. As the body count grows, Tommy begins to question his sanity and wonder if Jason has risen from the dead. But, to determine the killer's identity, Tommy will need to survive. - John Shepherd, Melanie Kinnaman, Shavar Ross, Richard Young, Marco St. John (Horror, Thriller, Mystery, Action, Drama)

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
programme.desc: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman. - John Doman (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: Personality Crisis: One Night Only
programme.desc: A portrait of musician David Johansen from Martin Scorsese and David Tedeschi; featuring a live performance at Café Carlyle in New York City, along with new and archival interviews. (Special, Documentary, Music)

programme.title: Wild Wild West
programme.desc: When President Ulysses S. Grant (Kevin Kline) learns that diabolical inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) is planning to assassinate him, he orders Civil War hero James West (Will Smith) and U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon (also Kline) to arrest him. West's trigger-happy personality doesn't always mesh well with that of the thoughtful Gordon, but they manage to work together. And with the help of a mysterious stranger (Salma Hayek), West and Gordon close in on Loveless. - Will Smith, Kevin Kline, Kenneth Branagh, Salma Hayek, Ted Levine (Action, Western, Comedy, Adventure, Science fiction)

programme.title: Star Trek: Section 31
programme.desc: Emperor Philippa Georgiou faces the sins of her past after joining a secret division of Starfleet that's tasked with protecting the United Federation of Planets. - Michelle Yeoh, Omari Hardwick, Kacey Rohl, Sam Richardson, Sven Ruygrok (Science fiction, Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect. - Richard Gere, Laura Linney, Edward Norton, John Mahoney, Alfre Woodard (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world. - John Goodman, Mary Elizabeth Winstead, John Gallagher Jr., Douglas M. Griffin, Suzanne Cryer (Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, Olivia Taylor Dudley, C. Ernst Harth (Thriller)

programme.title: Fight or Flight
programme.desc: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking a high-value asset known only as "The Ghost" on an international flight. Realizing the plane is filled with assassins assigned to kill them both, the pair must work together in a fight for their lives. - Josh Hartnett, Charithra Chandran, Marko Zaror, Katee Sackhoff, Julian Kostov (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Wild Wild West
programme.desc: When President Ulysses S. Grant (Kevin Kline) learns that diabolical inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) is planning to assassinate him, he orders Civil War hero James West (Will Smith) and U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon (also Kline) to arrest him. West's trigger-happy personality doesn't always mesh well with that of the thoughtful Gordon, but they manage to work together. And with the help of a mysterious stranger (Salma Hayek), West and Gordon close in on Loveless. - Will Smith, Kevin Kline, Kenneth Branagh, Salma Hayek, Ted Levine (Action, Western, Comedy, Adventure, Science fiction)

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect. - Michael Douglas, Sharon Stone, George Dzundza, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Denis Arndt (Thriller)

programme.title: Erotic Obsession
programme.desc: Mandy thinks she has found the perfect roommate in her coworker, Michele. But when an innocent comment is misinterpreted by Michele, things quickly escalate from Platonic roommates to full on infatuation. - Abella Danger, Chanel Preston, Adria Rae (Adults only, Erotic)

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect. - Richard Gere, Laura Linney, Edward Norton, John Mahoney, Alfre Woodard (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: The Longest War
programme.desc: The human stories and drama behind America's involvement in Afghanistan, now the longest war in U.S. history; features interviews with intelligence operatives, soldiers, families, Afghan officials, journalists, and government and military officials. (Special, Documentary, Military, War)

programme.title: All Up in the Biz
programme.desc: Celebrity interviews and rare archival footage provide insight into the life and legacy of hip-hop icon Biz Markie. (Documentary, Music, Hip-Hop & rap)

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents. - Angelina Jolie, Gerard Butler, Ciarán Hinds, Christopher Barrie, Noah Taylor (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Faster
programme.desc: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. - Dwayne Johnson, Billy Bob Thornton, Oliver Jackson-Cohen, Carla Gugino, Maggie Grace (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: For Greater Glory: The True Story of Cristiada
programme.desc: In late 1920s Mexico, retired Gen. Gorostieta and his wife watch their country degenerate into violent civil war when the government enacts a series of anti-clerical laws. Gorostieta is at first hesitant to join the rebels, known as Cristeros, until he begins to see the cost of religious persecution on his countrymen. Though the odds are against him, the general nevertheless transforms a ragtag band of rebels into a formidable fighting force. - Andy Garcia, Eva Longoria, Peter O'Toole, Oscar Isaac, Santiago Cabrera (Historical drama)

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss. - Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem, Josh Brolin, Woody Harrelson, Kelly Macdonald (Crime drama, Thriller, Western)

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: An eight-year-old Amish boy witnesses a drug-related murder in a Philadelphia train station. The Philadelphia police captain discovers that the murderers are cops trying to squelch a corruption investigation. - Harrison Ford, Kelly McGillis, Alexander Godunov, Josef Sommer, Lukas Haas (Crime drama, Romance, Thriller)

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: An acting CIA chief (Harrison Ford) learns the president has triggered a war with Colombian drug cartels.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: Jack Ryan (Ben Affleck) and the CIA director (Morgan Freeman) try to stop terrorists who are planning a nuclear attack.

programme.desc: S4E9 - The guys try to build a 1,200-square foot cabin using barn beams from their inventory; Mark's friend shows up to make a one-of-a-kind whiskey tap out of an unused beam end. (Reality, How-to, Home improvement, Documentary)

programme.title: This Old House - Arlington Arts & Crafts: Arts and Crafts Class Begins
programme.desc: S38E1 - Exploring what has been preserved and altered over the years; the plans for the second and third floors; how the homeowners envision using the outdoor space; the inefficient boiler; plans for future mechanical and plumbing systems; outdated kitchen. (Home improvement, How-to, House/garden)

programme.title: This Old House - Arlington Arts & Crafts: A New Look, Inside and Out
programme.desc: S38E2 - Jill Goldberg sorts through colors and wallpaper ideas for the living room; old plaster walls are demolished; Kim Turner presents her first landscape plan; a certified arborist removes the old Silver Maple; the exterior back wall is taken down. (Home improvement, How-to, House/garden)

programme.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Blue Toes and Shower Woes in Avon North Carolina
programme.desc: S7E1 - After discovering Avon, N.C., during a beach vacation, a family of four searches for a fixer-upper to call their own; once they've found their hidden gem, it's all hands on deck as renovations become a family affair involving multiple generations. (Reality, House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Family Reno on Dauphin Island
programme.desc: S5E5 - A couple looks for an escape from Las Vegas on the coast of Alabama's Dauphin Island; they want a property that offers plenty of room for improvements, but they must find a way to add their personal touch while keeping costs down. (Reality, House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Weekend Warriors in the Outer Banks
programme.desc: S6E3 - A couple looks for a family beach getaway in the Outer Banks along the shores of Avon, N.C.; the family of do-it-yourselfers tackles the home's major projects and repurpose as much as they can to keep renovation costs down. (Reality, House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - All Hands on Deck on Whidbey Island
programme.desc: S5E11 - A couple combs the picturesque Washington coastline to find the perfect beachside retreat on Whidbey Island. (Reality, House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Vacation Renovation in Texas
programme.desc: S6E5 - A married couple from Houston search for a family getaway in the laid-back town of Surfside Beach, Texas; they've renovated homes before and aren't afraid of a little work, especially when it could get them a beach house at an affordable price. (Reality, House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Lookin' for Low-Cost Renovations in the Low Country
programme.desc: S5E2 - A couple from Charlotte looks for a beach getaway on South Carolina's Hilton Head Island; renovating the home before the prime rental season starts presents an even bigger challenge. (Reality, House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Bottle Island
programme.desc: S3E1 - John Beal is ready to leave the city behind and embrace an off-the-grid life in Isla Mujeres, Mexico; Beal hires Richart Sowa and his son, Eden, to build an eco-friendly private floating island made from recycled plastic bottles. (House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Georgia Mountain Cavern
programme.desc: S13E2 - A young family embarks on their biggest and most challenging build yet -- an in-earth cavern in the mountains of northern Georgia. But building on a mountain will be anything but easy as they deal with a rocky terrain, extreme heat and heavy rain. (House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Alaskan Glacier
programme.desc: S2E1 - Alaskan adventure guide Don Lee builds a remote survival cabin on top of a glacier, a site plagued with avalanches and unpredictable weather. (House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Idaho Barndominium
programme.desc: S12E10 - An outdoor enthusiast works to build his dream retirement home in the Idaho mountains, but weather and material shortages slow his timeline. (House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Texas Luxury Tent
programme.desc: S13E1 - A Texas couple teams up with two South African canvas tent experts to create their dream glamping experience; but they soon find the build is anything but luxurious; with rain, heat, and critters, they have to work together to reach the finish line. (House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Mountain Dome Home
programme.desc: S12E9 - A family of three in the North Georgia mountains is building a geodesic dome home at the top of their property; after endless rainstorms, their build site becomes inaccessible, and they question if their home will ever be completed. (House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Arizona Straw Bale Home
programme.desc: S13E3 - A couple plans to build their home out of straw bales in the Arizona desert in only six months; using Earthship architecture as their motivation, they hope to make this structure modern, durable and unique. (House/garden, Home improvement, How-to)

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Utah Desert Cabin
programme.desc: S11E7 - An overworked gymnastics coach begins working on his dream cabin in Utah's Wasatch Mountain Range; malfunctioning equipment, being far from town, extreme weather, and unpredictable wildlife threaten to turn his dream into a nightmare.

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Tennessee Dome Home
programme.desc: S10E3 - A couple looks to build an eco-friendly, off-the-grid geodesic dome, cooled using geothermal caves, with a view of Tennessee's South Cumberland Mountain Range; uncertain weather; an intricate design; treacherous mountain paths.

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Missouri Modern Farmhouse
programme.desc: S11E2 - A Missouri couple who have inherited property are now cleaning it up and building it out, but troubles multiply as hurricane rains flood the build site, a gigantic burn pile creates larger flames than expected, and materials arrive broken.

programme.title: Building Off the Grid - Georgia Mountain Silo
programme.desc: S11E1 - A couple sets out to build a tree-house retreat in northern Georgia overlooking the Blue Ridge Mountains; although the build calls for a mile-long, uphill trek with all of their materials, the end result is the ultimate childhood dream come true.

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.title: Intentional Talk (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball)

programme.desc: Host Kenny Beecham faces off against two of his colleagues, Darrick Miller and Mike Heard, in a rare 2v1 showdown. Themed around the NBA Finals, the trio digs into the series' history as the 2026 Finals approaches.

programme.title: Confess, Fletch
programme.desc: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend.

programme.title: Bad News Bears
programme.desc: A single mother (Marcia Gay Harden) recruits a former baseball player (Billy Bob Thornton) to coach a ragtag team of misfit Little Leaguers.

programme.title: Eric Clapton: Life in 12 Bars
programme.desc: Eric Clapton is widely renowned as one of the greatest performers of all time. His isolated pursuit of his craft, and fear of selling out, served as a catalyst for his evolution as an artist.

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Siblings (Freddie Highmore, Sarah Bolger) learn that magical creatures are behind the strange occurrences at their great-great-uncle's rundown estate.

programme.title: Bleed for This
programme.desc: With help from trainer Kevin Rooney, champion boxer Vinny Pazienza tries to make a comeback after breaking his neck in a car accident.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: A scholarship student (Brendan Fraser) hides his Jewish heritage to fit in at an Eastern prep school in the mid-1950s.

programme.title: Mean Creek
programme.desc: Quiet adolescent Sam (Rory Culkin) has been bullied by George (Josh Peck), a fellow student who has trouble fitting in with other teens. When Rocky (Trevor Morgan), Sam's elder brother, finds out Sam is being picked on, he enlists his buddies to help get back at George. They ask George to accompany them on a boating expedition deep in the woods, but when their plan to humiliate George horrifically backfires, the friends make a series of poor decisions that will change their lives. - Rory Culkin, Ryan Kelley, Scott Mechlowicz, Trevor Morgan, Josh Peck (Drama)

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: A smart high-school student with his heart set on going to Stanford is horrified when his guidance counselor accidentally sends the wrong transcript with his college application. He spends the rest of the film trying to prove that he's actually a good student with a terrific grade-point average. - Colin Hanks, Jack Black, Catherine O'Hara, Schuyler Fisk, John Lithgow (Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Jackass: Number Two
programme.desc: Daredevils (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O) go for the gross-out when they subject an unsuspecting public to more outrageous stunts and practical jokes. Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy. (Comedy, Docudrama)

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull." (Comedy, Docudrama)

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: Dante (Brian O'Halloran) is called in to cover a shift at his New Jersey convenience store on his day off. His friend Randal (Jeff Anderson) helps him pass the time, neglecting his video-store customers next door to hang out in the Quick Stop. The uneventful day is disrupted by news that one of Dante's ex-girlfriends has died. After attending her memorial service, Dante muses over staying with current girlfriend Veronica (Marilyn Ghigliotti) or reuniting with ex Caitlin (Lisa Spoonhauer). - Brian O'Halloran, Jeff Anderson, Marilyn Ghigliotti, Lisa Spoonhauer, Jason Mewes (Comedy)

programme.title: Lilies Not for Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another. - Fionn O'Shea, Robert Aramayo, Erin Kellyman, Louis Hofmann, Jodi Balfour (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Blue Eyed Girl
programme.desc: Summoned home to visit her two sisters and her ailing father, a woman starts to re-evaluate her life as she wonders what could have been. - Marisa Coughlan, Beau Bridges, Eliza Coupe, Freddy Rodriguez, Sam Trammell (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Raging Grace
programme.desc: Nothing is as it seems when an undocumented Filipina immigrant takes a job as a caretaker for a terminally ill man in a lavish home. She and her daughter soon become ensnared by a terrible secret that threatens to tear them apart. - Max Eigenmann, Jaeden Boadilla, Leanne Best, David Hayman, Oliver Wellington (Horror, Drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Brave the Dark
programme.desc: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart. - Nicholas Hamilton, Jared Harris, Sasha Bhasin, Will Price, Jamie Harris (Drama)

programme.title: Borg vs. McEnroe
programme.desc: It's the summer of 1980, and Björn Borg is the top tennis player in the world, dominating the sport both on and off the court. A powerful and rigorously disciplined player, there is only one obstacle in his pursuit of a record-breaking fifth Wimbledon championship: the highly talented but ferociously abrasive young American John McEnroe. With three days until the tournament begins, Borg trains religiously in his lavish Monaco home, aided by his coach and mentor Lennart and girlfriend Mariana. - Sverrir Gudnason, Shia LaBeouf, Stellan Skarsgård, Tuva Novotny, Ian Blackman (Drama)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Day of the Fight
programme.desc: On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure. - Michael C. Pitt, Joe Pesci, Ron Perlman, Steve Buscemi, Nicolette Robinson (Drama)

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. - Christoph Waltz, Lucy Liu, Cooper Hoffman, Ryan McParland, Ann Akinjirin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Sound of Violence
programme.desc: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain. - Jasmin Savoy Brown, Lili Simmons, James Jagger, Tessa Munro, Dana L. Wilson (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned. - Bryan Cranston, Jennifer Garner, Jason O'Mara, Beverly D'Angelo, Ian Anthony Dale (Drama)

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly. - Eric Roberts, Liam James Collins, Dallas Hart, Jonathan Peacy, Arthur Sylense (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Raging Grace

programme.title: Strange Darling
programme.desc: Nothing is what it seems when a twisted one-night stand spirals into a serial killer's vicious murder spree. - Willa Fitzgerald, Kyle Gallner, Ed Begley Jr., Barbara Hershey, Steven Michael Quezada (Thriller, Horror)

programme.title: The Perfect Score
programme.desc: College is up next for a group of high-school friends, so Francesca (Scarlett Johansson), the most daring of the group, suggests they steal SAT questions in order to increase their odds of getting into good universities. Hoop star Desmond (Darius Miles), studly Kyle (Chris Evans), working-class Matty (Bryan Greenberg), stoner Roy (Leonardo Nam) and foxy Anna (Erika Christensen) sign on for the scheme. But getting into the test facility after hours proves trickier than any multiple-choice exam. - Erika Christensen, Chris Evans, Bryan Greenberg, Scarlett Johansson, Darius Miles (Comedy)

programme.title: Bang Bang
programme.desc: Following Bang Bang Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past. - Tim Blake Nelson, Glenn Plummer, Andrew Liner, Kevin Corrigan, Nina Arianda (Drama)

programme.title: Wolves
programme.desc: Anthony is a standout player on his Manhattan high school's basketball team with seemingly everything going for him: a killer three-point shot, a loving girlfriend, and a chance at a scholarship to Cornell. But Anthony's dreams of playing college ball are jeopardized by his volatile father, a hard-drinking writer whose compulsive gambling threatens to derail the lives of both his wife and son. - Michael Shannon, Carla Gugino, Taylor John Smith, Chris Bauer, John Douglas Thompson (Drama)

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: A notorious crime boss forces two legendary car thieves to steal a vehicle to win back their freedom. Joined by two beautiful women, the team has one week to pull off the daring heist or risk losing everything, including their lives. - Scott Eastwood, Freddie Thorp, Ana de Armas, Gaia Weiss, Simon Abkarian (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: A chameleon who has lived as a sheltered family pet finds himself in the grip of an identity crisis. Rango wonders how to stand out when it is his nature to blend in. When he accidentally winds up in a frontier town called Dirt, he takes the first step on a transformational journey as the town's new sheriff. Though at first Rango only role-plays, a series of thrilling situations and outrageous encounters forces him to become a real hero. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Four Letters of Love
programme.desc: Nicholas and Isabel are made for each other, but as destiny pulls them together, family, passion and faith drives them apart. As they embark on journeys of heartache and misplaced love, fate soon contrives to pull the threads of their lives together. - Pierce Brosnan, Helena Bonham Carter, Gabriel Byrne, Ann Skelly, Fionn O'Shea (Romance, Drama)

An attorney harbors a fleeing slave on a voyage from the Pacific Islands in 1849; a poor composer in pre-World War II Britain struggles to finish his magnum opus before a past act catches up with him; a genetically engineered worker in 2144 feels the forbidden stirring of human consciousness -- and so on. As souls are born and reborn, they renew their bonds to one another throughout time. - Tom Hanks, Halle Berry, Jim Broadbent, Hugo Weaving, Jim Sturgess (Drama, Mystery, Science fiction)

programme.title: Armageddon
programme.desc: When an asteroid threatens to collide with Earth, NASA honcho Dan Truman (Billy Bob Thornton) determines the only way to stop it is to drill into its surface and detonate a nuclear bomb. This leads him to renowned driller Harry S. Stamper (Bruce Willis), who agrees to helm the dangerous space mission provided he can bring along his own hotshot crew. Among them is the cocksure A.J. (Ben Affleck), who Harry thinks isn't good enough for his daughter (Liv Tyler), until the mission proves otherwise. - Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton, Liv Tyler, Ben Affleck, Will Patton (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Thriller, Fantasy)

As tensions between the new neighbors start to rise, a new threat soon propels both clans on an epic adventure that forces them to embrace their differences, draw strength from one another, and survive together. programme.title: The Help
programme.desc: In the 1960s Mississippi, Southern society girl Skeeter returns from college with dreams of being a writer. She turns her small town on its ear by choosing to interview the Black women who have spent their lives taking care of prominent white families. Only Aibileen, the housekeeper of Skeeter's best friend, will talk at first. But as the pair continue the collaboration, more women decide to come forward, and as it turns out, they have quite a lot to say. - Viola Davis, Emma Stone, Bryce Dallas Howard, Octavia Spencer, Jessica Chastain (Historical drama)

programme.title: Save the Last Dance
programme.desc: Sara moves from a small Midwestern town to the south side of Chicago when her mother dies in a car accident, and must live with her father. She soon falls for an African American teenager at her new high school, and he has less than an idyllic past. They share a love for dance (ballet and hip hop respectively) and together they tackle the problems that go with an interracial relationship. - Julia Stiles, Sean Patrick Thomas, Kerry Washington, Fredro Starr, Terry Kinney (Romance, Comedy drama, Drama)

programme.title: Win a Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Secretly in love with his friend (Kate Bosworth), a supermarket manager (Topher Grace) becomes jealous when she meets a famous actor (Josh Duhamel).
